evidence.title: Pure DC Launches One of Europe’s Largest Ever AI Infrastructure Projects
evidence.excerpt: Pure DC reports that SJK01 Phase 1 is fully leased, all planning permissions and power requirements are secured, and the first-data-hall substation is constructed and live at its AI campus in Seinäjoki.
